content: Astro content collections support custom build-time loaders that fetch from any remote source (DB/CMS/API) during 'astro build', writing results into the static data store consumed by pages/layouts. For Firestore catalog data, write a custom loader using firebase-admin (or REST) that pulls games/tools/news at build time; this keeps pages fully static/prerendered while content stays admin-editable in Firestore. Astro also supports 'live' collections for on-demand fetches if occasional freshness beats full rebuild.
